title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1843: Carnage (1)

section.p: Three ancient marquises had died. The sky was collapsing.
The Daofuses of the various races were fleeing for their lives.

Beside Su Yu, June, Hou Pseudo Emperor, and the others were feeling incomparably excited. They had never fought a smoother war than this before. It felt great. They couldn’t believe this. The strength of Great Qin King and Great Xia King also caused them much excitement, but they were also feeling a slight sense of fear.

Su Yu seemed to have a never-ending supply of trump cards. It was as though he would never run out of trump cards. Who could have guessed that Great Qin King and Great Xia King were already Daofuses? There had been zero signs of this.

Su Yu’s life force was surging after killing three ancient marquises. He glanced around. Everyone was fleeing. However, some were still heading toward the Human Realm. When he focused, it was only one fool. The Nether Pseudo Emperor. He could understand what the Nether Pseudo Emperor was doing.
Su Yu decided not to return and waited in Nether Pseudo Emperor’s way back home. If he were to return, the Nether Pseudo Emperor would be able to move around them to escape.
“He’s already dead. Just ignore him.”
Su Yu did not pay the Nether Pseudo Emperor much attention. He would die for sure.

There was not only Wan Tiansheng there. Seven additional Daofuses were hidden there as well. All of them were guardians. Of course, it was likely that they wouldn’t interfere even if Wan Tiansheng couldn’t kill the Nether Pseudo Emperor. After all, Su Yu had ordered that they remain hidden unless absolutely necessary.

Su Yu looked toward the Divine Pseudo Emperor and divine race. He was actually very wary of them. They had been suspiciously silent as of late. Even the immortal race had lost a Daofuse, but the divine race had managed to avoid that fate even with only one Daofuse around. Furthermore, they hadn’t lost too many Eternals either.

Further away, the Celestial Dragon Marquis was also fleeing with three other Daofuses. Su Yu was in no rush to deal with the Phoenix Pseudo Emperor and Ape Pseudo Emperor. They would die sooner or later. Killing them now would only make him look more dangerous. That wasn’t a good thing as it might drive Tiangu into doing something desperate.

However, Su Yu really wanted to kill the Divine Pseudo Emperor. He had been too silent. Just like how a dog wouldn’t bark before biting, he felt way more dangerous than even Tiangu. A few new races had decided to stand against humanity as well. Su Yu wouldn’t mind killing them for their audacity.
After a while, Su Yu looked back and said, “Great Zhou King, teleport everyone and intercept Celestial Dragon Marquis’ group.”
“Understood.”
Great Zhou King answered loudly. He was filled with excitement as well.

It would have been extremely difficult for him to kill the Fallen Star Marquis alone. But the battle today had progressed extremely smoothly. In fact, it felt great. He only needed to utilize his dao power. The other experts would do the killing for him.

His character appeared, preparing for the teleportation. The Spatial Beast Pseudo Emperor was good at teleportation as well. Thus, the two were able to join hands and pinpoint the correct coordinates rapidly.
Great Zhou King asked, “Who is our priority target?”
“The three newcomers. There is no rush to kill the Celestial Dragon Marquis. But those newcomers are a surprise for me. I had not planned for them before this.”
In short, they would remove the new variables.
Just as Great Zhou King was about to launch the teleportation, he glanced at Su Yu again and asked with surprise, “Emperor Yu, you…”
“I’m going to the Fate Realm.”
“Hmm?”

Great Zhou King was alarmed to hear that. Su Yu explained, “Even with three Daofuses dead, things might still be dangerous. I will observe. We can’t be careless. What if the Fate Pseudo Emperor was trying to open the Upper Realm instead of helping us? Things might get even more dangerous for us.”
“That’s too dangerous.”
It was too dangerous for Su Yu to go alone. Great Zhou King offered, “I can go with you—”
Su Yu said, “Just follow the order. Go now and stop them.”

He glanced at the escaping Jiwu. With a frown, he roared, “Soul devourers and Grand Dream. Withdraw from the immortals and devils. Intercept and kill Jiwu. Force the old fossils of the divine race to show themselves. I refuse to believe that they only have one Daofuse down here.”
“Whaaaaat? I’m on the verge of eating Tiangu!”
Soy Bun protested.
Tiangu was so near! He had already eaten a finger of Tiangu so far! He wouldn’t be that far away from eating the entire Tiangu! Tiangu was so tasty! He didn’t want to leave.
Su Yu said, “Kill Jiwu first. Tiangu still has more trump cards. He won’t be easy to kill.”
Su Yu was shouting without hiding anything. His voice was transmitted through the dao, spreading throughout the Allheaven Battlefield. Tiangu’s expression changed slightly.

Soy Bun and Flatbun were quite unhappy about it, but they did as told and started flying toward the Divine Realm. Far away, the old turtle withdrew decisively as well. Even when he was facing three Daofuses, he was able to pull back immediately.

Tiangu, Moji, and the others did not bother to stop them. They had yet to recover from their shock. At the same time, they were too alarmed to do anything. All these Daofuses were surprisingly cooperative.

It was as though no order would be left unfollowed. With one order by Su Yu, all the Daofuses in his alliance would carry it out without any hesitation. They could ignore their realms or the Human Realm just to carry out Su Yu’s order.

They did not care if they were winning or losing against their current opponents. For example, the old turtle was having the absolute upper hand against his three opponents. He was on the verge of killing the Ape Pseudo Emperor. Even so, he had withdrawn without any hesitation.
Nobody dared to stop him.
Near the Divine Realm.

Jiwu had an unsightly expression as he fled madly toward the Divine Realm. Sensing the fluctuations from the River of Time, he couldn’t keep calm anymore. He roared, “Tiangu, slow them down slightly?”

Did Tiangu want him dead? Their side was still quite powerful, but their morale had bottomed out. It wouldn’t be wrong to call them straggling and disbanded soldiers from how they were behaving. Celestial Dragon Marquis and the three Daofuses were also fleeing fearfully. None of them dared to fight anymore.

Their alliance was different from Su Yu’s. He had spent a lot of time suppressing and establishing his might among his alliance. Meanwhile, the myriad races had only formed an alliance of benefits. Tiangu had a light authority to plan things out, but he couldn’t fully order the other Daofuses around.

Such an alliance could work well when everything was going smoothly. But in a difficult battle, it would collapse. Without a truly powerful being to lead them, they would fall apart easily at the first sign of trouble. And right now, they were experiencing this exact scenario.
Noticing that the Divine Pseudo Emperor was about to be intercepted, Tiangu frowned. If Divine Pseudo Emperor were to die as well, the myriad race alliance down here would truly fall apart.
But…Jiwu…

Tiangu’s eyes flickered. Jiwu had been keeping a suspiciously low profile. Or to be precise, the entire divine race had been suspiciously silent. No Divine had descended from above, and no old fossil had awakened in the Lower Realm.

Even the devils had contributed more than them. The divine, devil, and immortals were supposed to be equal in strength. The immortals had lost two Daofuses while the devils had lost one. Meanwhile, the divines had yet to lose even a ninth-degree Eternal.

With that thought in mind, Tiangu roared, “Celestial Dragon Marquis and the others, enter the Dragon Realm and hide inside! Do not attempt to return to your own realms right now! Take shelter in the Dragon Realm!”

Just as the Celestial Dragom Marquis was about to say something, the golden crow soared into the sky and vanished. His voice rang out, “No. We will only be Eternals in the Dragon Realm. We can only remain Daofuses in our own realms! Is Celestial Dragon Marquis capable of stopping the humans alone in his realm?”

They felt much safer in their own realms. At the very least, they would be stronger in their realms. Even when they were being attacked, there was still hope. It was still too risky for the human alliance to invade too deeply into a relatively powerful race.

But entering the Dragon Realm? What a good idea by Tiangu. Had he not considered the fate of the other members of their races without them? Tiangu was essentially telling them to give up on their own races.
Just then, space warped as eight experts emerged. Countless attacks rained down from the sky.
“Patience.”
“Calm!”
With a roar, Great Zhou King utilised his calm and patient characters. The golden crow, who had just departed, suddenly roared as flames raged around him.
Staying patient?
Yes. His mind was being interfered with. But this was a matter of life and death. Thus, he burned his very dao to force himself to stay rational.
He couldn’t be patient!
He would die if he were patient!
Seeing that the golden crow was stopped, the other three Daofuses did not even bother to help. Instead, Celestial Dragon Marquis dove down toward the Dragon Realm without any hesitation.
The kunpeng dove into the Sea of Stars, while the three-headed demon wolf continued his escape back to his own realm. They had a shared wish. They wished that the golden crow wouldn’t die so fast.
If the golden crow were to die too fast, those people would be able to go after the others. But how long could the golden crow last facing eight super experts?
Nine daos clashed in the sky.
The golden crow had a look of desperation. He lost all his motivation to fight as he smiled bitterly, “I have been hiding stupidly for countless years only to participate when it’s time to die.”

He was filled with boundless resignation. When he first saw the three marquises, he had thought that this was his chance to win the favour of the myriad races. He had stayed neutral for countless years. But at the very end, he had picked a side to die without gaining any benefits. How could he not feel bitter about this?
“Golden crow race, seal the realm.”
The Golden Crow Pseudo Emperor gave his final order, “Seal the realm with the lives of Eternals. Sever all connections with the outside world before the Upper Realm opens.”
Then, a massive explosion erupted, pushing the eight experts back. Up above, a dao collapsed. Yet another rain of blood was generated while crimson clouds filled the sky.
Great Xia King spat and complained, “Old Zhou, why did your turtle dao fail?”
The golden crow was able to self-detonate.
With a pale expression, Great Zhou King said, “You can try doing the same thing repeatedly on top of multiple teleportations. Let’s see how long you can last.”

Did they think that he had boundless energy? He had exhausted a lot of his energy doing all that! After killing several Daofuses, he was almost fully drained. It was simply impossible for him to continue suppressing these Daofuses, who were already in full desperation.
“Fine, fine. You are now as good as a cripple. Just focus on serving as the teleporter for now.”
Great Xia King said, “Hurry up! Let’s chase the kunpeng!”
Great Zhou King looked over and said, “It’s too late to go after the kunpeng. We can go after the three-headed demon wolf instead.”
The kunpeng was already right in front of his realm. Not even teleportation would be enough for them to catch up. But they could still catch the three-headed demon wolf.

Great Zhou King and Spatial Beast Pseudo Emperor worked together to teleport them toward the three-headed demon wolf. Noticing what they were doing, the demon wolf roared with desperation and tore space apart before stepping into the River of Time. Then, he ignited his blood essence as he fled even faster.
He only had one goal: return home.
Otherwise, he would die.

The kunpeng had successfully returned. The Celestial Dragon Marquis had returned as well. It wouldn’t be too easy for the humans to invade their realms. But killing stragglers outside was still an easy feat for them.
Four Daofuses had died thus far. He did not want to be the fifth. No, he did not.
